ns2:section.sectionText: Food safety systems and sanitation in food manufacturing and/or processing. Topics include FDA and USDA regulations and updates, HACCP principles, good manufacturing practices, international issues. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. Online scheduled class sessions require that each student have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. This section has one or more proctored exams, which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU and approved proctoring centers. For ProctorU technical specifications and additional information visit: http://www.ao.uiuc.edu/support/source/student_services/proctoru_tech.html. Priority registration will be given to FSHN MS Online degree seeking students through July 15, 2014. Pending seating availability, non-degree seeking students may enroll after July 15. To be added to the course wait-list, email a request to annamehl@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $394.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $359.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
